# Pratham Capital

> Pratham Capital is an India-based financial services company providing Home Loans, Personal Loans, Business Loans, Mutual Funds, SIP Investments, Insurance, Forex Services, and Wealth Management.

## Company

Pratham Capital provides financial advisory and distribution services across India. Services include home loans, personal loans, business loans, mutual fund investments, SIP planning, insurance, forex services, and wealth management through trusted financial institutions and partners.
